# CLI reference

Every `tps2` command, generated from the Typer app. Run any command with `--help` for the same information in the terminal.

## `tps2`

TopoPyScale 2.0 -- Topographic downscaling of meteorological forcing

| Command | Summary |
|---|---|
| `tps2 build-cache` | Build a regional ERA5 Zarr cache for fast local access. |
| `tps2 evaluate-clusters` | Evaluate cluster quality metrics to help choose n_clusters. |
| `tps2 export` | Export a run's forcing as input files for an impact model. |
| `tps2 fetch-forcing` | Fetch NWP forcing data (ERA5 or IFS). |
| `tps2 info` | Show domain summary information including Phase 2 configuration. |
| `tps2 init` | Initialize a new simulation directory with template config. |
| `tps2 preflight` | Run preflight checks on config before starting a simulation. |
| `tps2 run` | Run full pipeline: setup -> fetch -> downscale -> write output. |
| `tps2 setup` | Set up domain: DEM acquisition, terrain processing, clustering. |
| `tps2 ui` | Open a local page to configure a run, start it and view the result. |
| `tps2 view` | Write a self-contained HTML page of the downscaled forcing. |

### `tps2 build-cache`

Build a regional ERA5 Zarr cache for fast local access.

Downloads ERA5 data and consolidates into a single Zarr store with
optimised regional chunking. Subsequent simulations using backend=local
read from this cache in seconds instead of re-downloading.

Examples:

    tps2 build-cache ./era5_cache/region.zarr --bbox 60,25,105,50 --time 2000-01-01,2024-12-31

    tps2 build-cache ./era5_cache/region.zarr --info

    tps2 build-cache ./era5_cache/region.zarr --update

| Parameter | Kind | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `OUTPUT` | argument | path |  | yes | Path to output Zarr store (e.g. ./era5_cache/region.zarr) |
| `--bbox`, `-b` | option | text |  |  | Bounding box: west,south,east,north (e.g. 60,25,105,50) |
| `--time`, `-t` | option | text |  |  | Time range: start,end (e.g. 2000-01-01,2024-12-31) |
| `--levels`, `-l` | option | text | 1000,925,850,800,700,600,550,500,400,300 |  | Comma-separated pressure levels in hPa |
| `--backend` | option | text | google |  | Download backend (google, cds, openmeteo) |
| `--workers`, `-w` | option | integer | 4 |  | Number of parallel download workers |
| `--resolution`, `-r` | option | text | 1H |  | Time resolution (1H, 2H, 3H, 6H) |
| `--update`, `-u` | flag | boolean | false |  | Update existing cache with new dates |
| `--info` | flag | boolean | false |  | Print cache metadata and exit |
| `--chunk-lat` | option | integer | 45 |  | Latitude chunk size |
| `--chunk-lon` | option | integer | 45 |  | Longitude chunk size |
| `--no-throttle` | flag | boolean | false |  | Disable adaptive rate limiting (not recommended for large builds) |
| `--yes`, `-y` | flag | boolean | false |  | Skip confirmation prompt |

### `tps2 evaluate-clusters`

Evaluate cluster quality metrics to help choose n_clusters.

Computes silhouette score, Calinski-Harabasz index, and Davies-Bouldin
index for the configured clustering. Optionally runs an elbow analysis
across a range of k values.

Metrics guide:
- Silhouette: -1 to 1 (higher = better separated clusters)
- Calinski-Harabasz: higher = denser, better separated
- Davies-Bouldin: lower = better separated
- Inertia: lower = tighter clusters (but always decreases with k)

| Parameter | Kind | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--config`, `-c` | option | path |  | yes | Path to YAML config file |
| `--elbow`, `-e` | flag | boolean | false |  | Run elbow analysis across a range of k values. |
| `--k-min` | option | integer | 50 |  | Minimum k for elbow analysis. |
| `--k-max` | option | integer | 5000 |  | Maximum k for elbow analysis. |
| `--k-steps` | option | integer | 8 |  | Number of k values to test in elbow analysis. |

### `tps2 export`

Export a run's forcing as input files for an impact model.

smet: SNOWPACK / Alpine3D / MeteoIO. fsm: FSM single-point files. fsm2: FSM2 multi-point
file. csv: one table per unit. crocus: Crocus / SURFEX FORCING. cryogrid: CryoGrid.
hbv: daily temperature, precipitation and PET (Hamon).

Examples:
    tps2 export ~/sim/davos --format smet
    tps2 export ~/sim/davos -f fsm -o ~/models/fsm/met

| Parameter | Kind | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SIM_DIR` | argument | path |  | yes | Simulation directory (after `tps2 run`) |
| `--format`, `-f` | option | text |  | yes | smet, fsm, fsm2, csv, crocus, cryogrid or hbv |
| `--output`, `-o` | option | path |  |  | Directory to write into (default: <sim_dir>/output/<format>) |

### `tps2 init`

Initialize a new simulation directory with template config.

Creates the directory structure:

    <path>/
    ├── config.yaml      # Configuration file (edit this)
    ├── run.sh           # Run script (customizable)
    ├── dem_cache/       # DEM data cached here
    ├── forcing_cache/   # ERA5 data cached here
    └── output/          # Downscaled output written here

After init, edit config.yaml to set your domain, time range, and options,
then run: ./run.sh (or: tps2 run --config <path>/config.yaml)

Examples:

    tps2 init ~/sim/alps_summer2023

    tps2 init ./my_run --bbox 7.5,46.0,7.7,46.2 --time 2023-06-01,2023-06-30

| Parameter | Kind | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PATH` | argument | path |  | yes | Path for new simulation directory |
| `--bbox`, `-b` | option | text |  |  | Bounding box as 'west,south,east,north' (e.g., '7.5,46.0,7.7,46.2') |
| `--time`, `-t` | option | text |  |  | Time range as 'start,end' (e.g., '2023-06-01,2023-06-03') |
| `--force`, `-f` | flag | boolean | false |  | Overwrite existing directory |

### `tps2 preflight`

Run preflight checks on config before starting a simulation.

Validates configuration parameters, checks backend availability,
estimates runtime and data volumes, and catches obvious misconfigurations
before committing to a multi-hour pipeline run.

Examples:

    tps2 preflight -c config.yaml

    tps2 preflight -c config.yaml --strict

    tps2 preflight -c config.yaml --skip-disk

| Parameter | Kind | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--config`, `-c` | option | path |  | yes | Path to YAML config file |
| `--strict` | flag | boolean | false |  | Exit code 1 on any warning (for CI). |
| `--skip-disk` | flag | boolean | false |  | Skip disk space check (useful for network storage). |

### `tps2 run`

Run full pipeline: setup -> fetch -> downscale -> write output.

Supports Phase 2 features:
- Polygon mode (HRU generation) when spatial_mode: polygons
- Winstral wind correction when wind method: winstral
- Snow redistribution when redistribution.wind_transport or avalanche enabled
- Multi-NWP source blending when sources configured

| Parameter | Kind | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--config`, `-c` | option | path |  | yes | Path to YAML config file |
| `--backend`, `-b` | option | text |  |  | Kernel backend (python\|rust\|jax). Overrides config if set. |
| `--primary`, `-p` | option | text |  |  | NWP source (era5\|ifs). Overrides config if set. |
| `--dry-run` | flag | boolean | false |  | Show what would be done without running. |
| `--raster` | flag | boolean | false |  | Also output gridded raster (time, y, x). |
| `--geotiff` | option | text |  |  | Variable to export as GeoTIFF series (e.g., temperature). |

### `tps2 setup`

Set up domain: DEM acquisition, terrain processing, clustering.

### `tps2 ui`

Open a local page to configure a run, start it and view the result.

Serves on 127.0.0.1 only (it has no login). Stop it with Ctrl+C.

Examples:
    tps2 ui ~/sim/davos
    tps2 ui ~/sim/davos --port 8800 --no-browser

| Parameter | Kind | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SIM_DIR` | argument | path | . |  | Simulation directory to configure and run (created if missing) |
| `--port`, `-p` | option | integer | 8765 |  | Port on 127.0.0.1 |
| `--no-browser` | flag | boolean | false |  | Do not open a browser tab |

### `tps2 view`

Write a self-contained HTML page of the downscaled forcing.

One offline file: pick temperature, precipitation, snowfall, shortwave, longwave, wind or
humidity and watch it through the season on the terrain, against elevation, and at any
terrain unit.

Examples:
    tps2 view ~/sim/alps_2023
    tps2 view ~/sim/alps_2023 -o alps.html --page page.yaml

| Parameter | Kind | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SIM_DIR` | argument | path |  | yes | Simulation directory (after `tps2 run`) |
| `--output`, `-o` | option | path |  |  | HTML file to write (default: <sim_dir>/output/forcing_page.html) |
| `--page` | option | path |  |  | YAML with the page's title, text, credits and logo |
| `--save-daily` | flag | boolean | false |  | Also write output/forcing_daily.nc, a compact daily summary the page can be rebuilt from |
